summary: Rails impose latency and maintenance cost, and over-restrictive sandboxes can prevent agents from completing otherwise routine work.

points.text: A permission prompt for every low-impact command produces approval fatigue and can be less safe than a well-designed bounded autonomy zone.
Rollback is not universally possible: external messages, data disclosure, purchases and destructive migrations can have irreversible effects.
Security benchmarks intentionally stress systems and do not by themselves quantify real deployment risk; local threat modeling remains necessary.
